thread:
sara (customer-success): Heads up — a handful of EU onboarding tenants are still showing incomplete indexing after last night's embedding reindex job. ClearPath flagged this as blocking their trial demo. Need a short status + RCA we can send to affected customers and a mitigation/credit offer. High renewal-risk signal on ClearPath, please prioritize.
amanda (cs lead): Thanks — who can give a concise RCA we can paste into the message? We should include: what happened, what we did to fix, ETA for completion, and an explicit credit/comp offer + optional office hours. Keep it <6 bullet points.
jon (eng): RCA summary: the nightly reindex backfill spawned too many worker tasks against the EU dedicated pool. Two things combined: a recent scheduler change removed a concurrency cap, and one of the reindex shards hit transient disk pressure on node-gpu-24 which retried aggressively. Result: extra 503s and a backlog. Immediate actions: paused the job, killed the runaway workers, applied per-shard rate limiting. Longer-term: reintroduce concurrency cap and add disk pressure alerts.
mike (ops): Mitigation/status: paused at 02:15 UTC, resumed rate-limited backfill at 04:20 UTC with 25% throughput. Backfill is progressing at ~40% of original speed; expected catch-up ~16–20h for all affected tenants, ClearPath estimated finish ~14–18h from now (depends on shard retries). Also cleared node-gpu-24 cache and added temp buffer capacity to reduce retry storms.
amanda (cs lead): Great — draft customer note below. Please review and flag edits. We want to be clear + empathetic, not too technical. Offer: 1 week free of Dedicated credits + invite to a 1:1 troubleshooting office hour if they want. Draft:

```Hi <Customer name>,

Quick update from Redwood: during a scheduled embedding reindex last night, a rate-control regression caused our EU reindex job to overload a node which triggered transient errors and slowed index completion for a small number of onboarding accounts (including yours). We paused the reindex, fixed the rate control, and resumed a rate-limited backfill.

What happened: a scheduler change removed a concurrency cap and one node experienced disk pressure, which together caused retries and a backlog.

What we did: paused the job, killed the retrying workers, applied per-shard rate limits, cleared the affected node cache, and added temporary buffer capacity.

Current status & ETA: the backfill is underway and progressing. We expect your project to finish indexing within the next 16–20 hours. We will update you once complete or earlier if anything changes.

Next steps for you: no action required. If you need pre-demo checks, we can prioritize a targeted reindex for your tenant — let us know and we’ll schedule.

Compensation: we’d like to offer one week of complimentary Dedicated credits applied to your account as an apology for the delay.

If you'd like to discuss this directly, we're happy to set up a 1:1 office hour with our eng/CS team.

Apologies for the disruption — we know this timing is important for your demo. Reply here or to <sara@redwood.ai> and I’ll coordinate the next steps.

Thanks,
Sara on behalf of Redwood Inference Operations
```

sara (customer-success): This reads well. Jon — is the technical line OK to include? "scheduler change removed a concurrency cap" — not trying to expose config details, but need accuracy.
jon (eng): That's fine at a high level. If you want even less config detail: change to "a recent change removed a safety throttle". Both accurate.
amanda (cs lead): I'll swap that phrasing. Also recommend we include a single-sentence internal exec note for ClearPath's AE: "we expect indexing done in ~16–18h; offering 1 week credits + prioritized reindex if needed. Escalate to eng if not done by X+20h." Add me + sara on the outbound.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0482 — Embedding backfill overload (EU). Severity: P3. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0482
mike (ops): Quick ask — if we need to prioritize ClearPath reindex, we can run a targeted warm-path reindex now (costlier) and finish in ~1–2h. Need CS approval to proceed.
sara (customer-success): Let's hold targeted warm-path unless the customer asks — start with the rate-limited backfill and update them. If they request demo-ready state sooner, we'll run the targeted job and let them know extra step may incur additional cost (we'll cover it for the trial). Amanda, can you send the note to ClearPath + two other affected onboarders (Mingle Labs, BrightLeaf) and cc me + jon? Please send within the hour.
amanda (cs lead): Sending now. I'll paste the note above, adjust wording to "safety throttle" per Jon, and include the credit & optional office hour. Will report back when sent + copy of outbound message.
sara (customer-success): Thanks — please also post a short tracker in the customer-health dashboard: Impact=Onboarding indexing delay, ETA=16–20h, Credit=1 week Dedicated, Escalation owner=amanda.
amanda (cs lead): Done — sent to leads for ClearPath & Mingle Labs. Copy of email sent to thread:

"Hi <lead>, we wanted to share a quick update: [paste note]. We're tracking completion ETA ~16–20h and applied a 1-week Dedicated credit. If you need us to accelerate to demo-ready within 2 hours, reply and we'll prioritize a targeted reindex. — Amanda (CS)"

sara (customer-success): Perfect. I'll follow up with the AE and flag renewal risk. If backfill slips past 20h or any new 5xx spikes appear, we escalate to P2.
jon (eng): I'll keep monitoring and post any infra changes. Will add the concurrency-cap fix to the rolling patch tomorrow morning.
amanda (cs lead): Thanks team. Will log the customer replies and any ask for targeted reindex here. :thumbsup
